evidence.snippet: const { data: session, error: sessionError } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
evidence.why: Identity is derived from a server-verified session, not from client-supplied input.
Ownership predicate bound to verified session identity sits inside the query WHERE clause.

controls_present: 404 instead of 403 to avoid leaking existence
other_classes_observed: use of SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in server client bypasses RLS (defense-in-depth concern, but ownership still enforced in query)
